name: ISR Townsend Hall to CIF
source: OpenStreetMap via Nominatim + Overpass API (ODbL), queried 2026-09-10 and 2026-09-11; WP1 = OSM entrance node 5418851678 at the south vestibule of the ISR lounge building, at Townsend Hall's south-west corner (Townsend = east building, OSM way 899305028), confirmed against University Housing ISR site plan + 1st-floor plan (hsgintranet2024.web.illinois.edu, 2025-11); intersections = OSM street-intersection/crossing nodes, WP5 interpolated mid-block; not yet walked/GPS-verified

waypoints.name: the Townsend Hall doors
waypoints.say: Leaving Townsend Hall through the ISR front doors. Follow the covered walk south, then the path west and down to the Illinois Street sidewalk.

waypoints.name: the Illinois Street sidewalk
waypoints.say: Illinois Street sidewalk. Turn right and walk west. Goodwin Avenue is about 175 meters ahead.

waypoints.name: Goodwin Avenue
waypoints.say: Goodwin Avenue. Intersection. Turn right to face north and stay on this side. No crossing needed. Listen for traffic.

waypoints.name: Green Street
waypoints.say: Green Street. Crossing. Signalized, push button. Listen for traffic, then cross and continue north.

waypoints.name: the middle of Goodwin
waypoints.say: Halfway up Goodwin. Keep going north. Springfield Avenue is about 125 meters ahead.

waypoints.name: Springfield Avenue
waypoints.say: Springfield Avenue. Turn left to face west. Crossing Goodwin, signalized, push button. Listen for traffic, then cross and keep walking west.

waypoints.name: Mathews Avenue
waypoints.say: Mathews Avenue. Crossing. Listen for traffic, then cross and continue west. CIF is about 150 meters ahead.

waypoints.name: the path to CIF
waypoints.say: CIF is ahead on your left. Turn left and follow the path south-west to the east entrance.

waypoints.name: the CIF east entrance
waypoints.say: You have arrived at the Campus Instructional Facility, east entrance.
